Flatten a Parsed .Rd Node to Text

Source: R/ast.R
collect_rd_text.Rd

Recursively concatenates the text of a tools::parse_Rd() node, optionally skipping subsections by Rd_tag (for instance "\\dontrun" when collecting example code that is meant to run).

Usage

collect_rd_text(node, skip = character(0))

Arguments

node

An Rd node, such as one returned by extract_rd_section().

skip

Character vector of Rd_tag values to omit from the text.

Value

A single character string.

See also

extract_rd_section().

Examples

rd_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".Rd")
writeLines(c("\\name{foo}", "\\title{Foo}",
             "\\examples{ f() \\dontrun{ g() } }"), rd_file)
rd <- tools::parse_Rd(rd_file)
collect_rd_text(extract_rd_section(rd, "\\examples"), skip = "\\dontrun")
#> [1] " f()  "
